response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS baseline FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.baseline) IS NULL, p.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC, p.order_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric strings, so it is cast to REAL before averaging; only NULL counts as missing (empty or non-numeric strings are not treated specially).
Orders whose quantities are all NULL are still listed, with NULL average and NULL difference (sorted last), but they are excluded from the baseline.
Ties in the difference are broken by order_id ascending, which the request does not specify.
